headlines.title: Two goals in 15 games - what's going on with Gyokeres?
headlines.description: Arsenal have made an impressive start to the campaign but it has been a frustrating one for striker Viktor Gyokeres.

headlines.title: Arsenal and PSG keen on Nusa - Tuesday's gossip
headlines.description: Arsenal and PSG are both looking at a move for RB Leipzig winger Antonio Nusa, Xabi Alonso has Chelsea hierarchy backing, Liverpool open contract talks with keeper Alisson Becker, plus more.

headlines.title: Raya to miss Dortmund game but injury 'not serious'
headlines.description: Arsenal goalkeeper David Raya will miss Tuesday's Champions League game against Borussia Dortmund but his shoulder injury will not require an operation.
